acceptance.$comment: Informational for reviewers; proofManifestSchema ignores unknown keys. Each criterion names the executable gate that decides it.

criteria.text: The waybill desk offers exactly the real work the projection contains, and Highball is reached only from a genuinely clean board.
Every scenario beat marked mustChange moves pixels inside its own layout-derived region AND satisfies its seamPredicate - pixels changed and the seam agrees why.
Motion/stillness duality: the idle yard reads alive with motion allowed, and holds still (never blank) under prefers-reduced-motion, within feel-budgets.json reducedMotion.maxChangedPixelPct.
Every character clip in assets/assets_index.json is reachable from some scenario+tick, or is listed in KNOWN_UNBOUND_CLIPS with a written reason.
A keyboard-only path reaches and confirms a command sheet; every keyboard stop carries a visible focus treatment in both themes; axe-core reports no serious/critical violations on the DOM chrome.
Synthetic data is labelled SIMULATED (presenter item plus seam world.demo) and live data is not; reduced-motion information parity holds for incident beats.
An experience-review report exists at public/shots/experience-review.json, and no HYX item median has dropped by 1.0 or more against its trailing-5 median.
criteria.gate: pnpm --filter @hobo/pixel-village run review:experience; run review:drift (advisory; --strict at milestones)
